This data layer is the refined wetlands for the Humber River Watershed Plan project. The layer includes refined Ecological Land Classification vegetation communities, MNRF, natural cover wetlands, that is exported from QA/QC final result (S:\ProjectMgmt_2020\DevlpEngServices\WshdPlnReporting\EtobicokeCreekWatershedPlan_29April2020\Watershed_Characterization\NaturalCover_QAQC\result\Naturalcover_wetlands_QAQC_HRWP_final_29July2020.gdb\ELC_MNRwetlands_naturalcover2017_merge).  
Data source: 2020 MNR wetlands, 2019 ELC, 2017 natural cover, restoration wetland data
